releaseNotes:
🎯 v1.8.4 Contextual AI Intelligence & 40s Human Pacing Delay:
• 🧠 Contextual Conversation Pivot: Directly answers customer questions first (e.g. 'Are you open today?' -> 'Yes, we are open today!') without robotic premature booking intake
• ⏱️ 40-Second Human Pacing Delay: Outgoing text messages now wait exactly 40 seconds before dispatching via SIM, simulating natural human reading and typing
• ⚡ Gemini 3.6 Flash Multi-Model Engine: Instant sub-second AI reasoning with multi-model fallback across Gemini 3.6, 3.1-Lite, and 3.8
• 🛡️ Smart Conversational Fallbacks: Context-aware responses even under extreme network dropouts
